chitchat: Consul Reyes greets someone she is currently undermining with genuine warmth.
"Diplomacy is simply war with better catering."
description: A career corporate diplomat who has negotiated three ceasefires and broken all of them personally. She is unfailingly gracious, which is how you know to be afraid.

accepted.text: "Marvellous. Oxide Flats and the Downwind, just past the Manifold's edge. Do be discreet; the whole point of downwind is that no one sees it."

bye.text: "Do give my regards to no one in particular."

quest_offer.text: "We dump our unpleasantness downwind, as one does, and something has moved into it — slag wights, fouling the very ground where a rather important accord is to be signed outdoors, for the optics. Clear two of them before the signing and the Concordat will remember you fondly, in bond form."

reported.text: "...The signing ground is clean, the delegates none the wiser, and everyone will take credit but you. Which is precisely why I'm paying you in a bond that names no one. We understand each other."

root.text: Consul Reyes turns to you with a smile of flawless, weaponised courtesy. "You have the look of someone who resolves things off the record. As it happens, I have a thing that requires resolving. Off the record."

clothing_layers: an immaculate consular coat with a discreet corporate pin
the armour of the perfectly composed

name: Consul Reyes
